newsitem.title: USA: Sears to open 110 stores in New York state.
newsitem.headline: Sears to open 110 stores in New York state.

text.p: Sears, Roebuck and Co, citing improved economic conditions in New York state, said Friday it plans to open 10 full-line department stores and more than 100 freestanding, specialty stores across the state of New York during the next four years.

The stores, which include a full-line department store opening this fall in Brooklyn, are projected to generate more than 5,000 new jobs and an additional $300 million in tax revenue, said Arthur Martinez, Sears chairman and chief executive officer, in a remarks prepared for delivery to a news conference in New York.

"Due to improved economic conditions in New York State and (New York) City, we are aggressively looking for new sites to better serve the needs of residents who want convenient shopping in their own neighborhoods," Martinez said.

Sears said this month it will begin a $20-million renovation of the former Alexander's Inc department store in Kings Plaza at Flatbush Avenue and Avenue U in Brooklyn. When completed, the store will be the largest Sears in metro New York and the second full-line store in Brooklyn.
Sears also is working on increasing its presence in other parts of New York City, including Manhattan, it said.
"We would like to add 10 full line department stores to the boroughs and the state by the end of the year 2000," Martinez said.

The company is involved in a bid to build a store on the New York Coliseum site at Columbus Circle. The proposed store would be the first full-line Sears in Manhattan in the company's 110-year history, Sears said.
Three other store sites have been identified: Kings Plaza, Yaphank and Bay Shore. Other potential store locations are under review by Sears management, it said.

Over the next four years, Sears also said more than 100 of the following freestanding stores are planned: Sears Hardware stores, NTW (National Tire Warehouse) and Tire America stores, Western Auto and Parts America stores and Sears Dealer stores.

Specific locations of new stores will be disclosed as real estate agreements are completed, Sears said. "It is anticipated that 30 percent of these new stores will be located in New York City," the company said.
Sears presently operates 130 retail stores and employs 15,000 people in New York state, counting full-line department stores and freestanding specialty stores.

Sears' ambitious effort in New York is part of a national, five-year, $4 billion program. The retailer said it plans to operate 5,000 stores nationwide by the year 2000, compared with its present total of about 3,300.
